## Portfolio Website Technical Details

**URL:** https://renohidayat.my.id/
**Hosting:** Firebase Hosting
**Framework:** React 18 with TypeScript
**Build Tool:** Vite
**Styling:** Tailwind CSS
**3D Engine:** Three.js with WebGL
**Animation Libraries:** Framer Motion, GSAP, Anime.js
**Scroll Engine:** Lenis (smooth scroll)
**Routing:** React Router DOM v6
**Internationalization:** Custom bilingual system (Indonesian/English)
**Analytics:** Vercel Analytics

### Notable Technical Features

1. **3D Interactive Hero Section:** Custom Three.js scene with orbit controls, rendering a 3D visual on the landing page
2. **Custom Cursor System:** Context-aware cursor that changes shape and behavior based on what the user hovers over
3. **Magnetic UI Elements:** Interactive elements that respond to cursor proximity using GSAP physics
4. **Scroll-Driven Animations:** Parallax marquee effects, stagger animations, and speed-based scroll elements
5. **Image Distortion Effect:** Hover-triggered distortion shader on project images
6. **Dynamic SEO:** Per-route meta tag updates for title, description, Open Graph, and canonical URL
7. **Responsive Design:** Dedicated mobile components and layouts alongside desktop experience
8. **Rounded Text Animation:** CSS-based circular text animation component
9. **Count-Up Statistics:** Animated number counters for key statistics

## Detailed Project Documentation

### Project 1: SIPENA — Sistem Informasi Ujian & Absensi FEB UNSAP

**Year:** 2026 (January — Present)
**Role:** System Analyst, Architect & Lead Backend
**Client:** Faculty of Economics & Business, Universitas Sebelas April
**URL:** https://github.com/Renohidayat/feb-unsap-exam
**Tech Stack:** Flutter, Dart, Firebase (Firestore, Realtime DB, Auth, Cloud Messaging), Node.js, React PWA

**Problem:** The faculty needed a scalable digital examination system to handle thousands of concurrent students with real-time monitoring, attendance tracking, and anti-cheat capabilities.

**Solution:** A distributed multi-platform ecosystem consisting of:
- **Android App** (Flutter): Student exam interface with real-time question delivery
- **iOS PWA** (React): Progressive Web App for iOS students
- **Web Admin** (React): Dashboard for exam management, monitoring, and reporting
- **Backend** (Node.js + Firebase): Serverless architecture with Firestore for exam data and Realtime Database for 10-second heartbeat monitoring

**Key Features:**
- Real-time 10-second heartbeat monitoring to detect student disconnections
- Background anti-cheat detection (app switching, screen recording attempts)
- Automated PDF "Berita Acara" (official minutes) generation
- Batch push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
- Automated attendance recapitulation with PDF export

**Impact:** Successfully deployed for campus-wide examinations handling concurrent student sessions.

### Project 2: Website FEB UNSAP — Official Faculty Portal

**Year:** 2025 — 2026
**Role:** Full Stack Web Developer
**Client:** Faculty of Economics & Business, Universitas Sebelas April
**URL:** https://feb.unsap.ac.id/
**Tech Stack:** Laravel 11, PHP 8.2, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, Vite, SB Admin 2

**Problem:** The faculty lacked a modern digital presence and content management system for academic information dissemination.

**Solution:** A full-featured web portal and CMS built with Laravel 11, featuring:
- **Public Frontend:** Responsive Tailwind CSS interface for news, events, and academic information
- **Admin Dashboard:** SB Admin 2 panel for content management
- **Academic Modules:** Study program profiles, faculty directory with tri-dharma records, event calendar, curriculum management

**Features:**
- Featured news and announcement publication system
- Faculty agenda and event management
- Study program curriculum display
- Lecturer/staff directory with academic records
- Responsive design for all devices

### Project 3: Jelajah Nusantara AI — Intelligent Travel Planner

**Year:** 2026
**Role:** Full Stack Developer
**URL:** https://jelajah-nusantara-ai.vercel.app/
**Tech Stack:** JavaScript, Vite, Node.js, Express, Firebase, DeepSeek AI, Leaflet.js, Chart.js

**Problem:** Travelers in Indonesia need personalized itinerary planning that considers budget, preferences, and local destinations.

**Solution:** An AI-powered travel planning platform using DeepSeek AI to generate intelligent daily itineraries with:
- **AI Itinerary Generation:** Smart travel schedules based on user preferences
- **Interactive Maps:** Leaflet.js integration for destination visualization
- **Budget Tracking:** Visual budget management with Chart.js radar and bar charts
- **Real-time Storage:** Firebase for user data persistence
- **Architecture:** Vercel Serverless monorepo with separate client and API packages

---

### Project 4: Sentiment Analysis — NLP Machine Learning Research

**Year:** 2026
**Role:** Researcher / Machine Learning Engineer
**URL:** https://sentimen-ijazah.vercel.app/
**Tech Stack:** Python, Scikit-learn, PySastrawi, FastAPI, React, Vite

**Research Context:** Analyzed public sentiment regarding President Jokowi's university degree controversy from YouTube comments.

**Methodology:**
- **Data Collection:** 2,561 comments scraped from 11 viral YouTube videos
- **Text Processing:** Indonesian NLP pipeline with PySastrawi stemmer, stopword removal, TF-IDF vectorization
- **Classification:** SVM with RBF kernel (Support Vector Machine — Radial Basis Function)
- **Evaluation:** 75.24% accuracy, 73.46% F1-score, Fleiss' Kappa 0.8635 (inter-annotator agreement)

**Deployment:** Full-stack application with FastAPI backend serving the trained model and React frontend for interactive sentiment visualization dashboard.

---

### Project 5: CGMI Assessment App — Civic GovTech

**Year:** 2026
**Role:** Web Developer
**Client:** Kabupaten Sumedang local government
**URL:** https://cgmi-assessmentt.web.app/
**Tech Stack:** JavaScript (Vanilla ES6), Tailwind CSS, Firebase, Chart.js, HTML5

**Purpose:** Measuring Collaboration Governance Maturity Index for local government agencies.

**Features:**
- 30-question assessment across 6 governance dimensions
- Automated scoring into 5 maturity levels
- Interactive Radar Chart visualization (Chart.js)
- Pure Vanilla JS ES6 modular architecture (no framework)
- Hybrid authentication: Access Code for respondents, Google OAuth for admin whitelist
- Firebase backend (Firestore + Authentication)

## Scientific Publication

**Title:** "Pengaruh Kesadaran dan Persepsi terhadap Keamanan Informasi terhadap Pengalaman Menghadapi Ancaman Siber: Pendekatan PLS-SEM"
**English Title:** "Impact of Information Security Awareness and Perception on Cyber Threat Experience: A PLS-SEM Approach"
**Author:** M. Reno Hidayat
**Published:** July 2025
**Platform:** ResearchGate
**DOI:** 10.13140/RG.2.2.28607.68009
**URL:** https://www.researchgate.net/publication/393644925

**Abstract:** This research investigates the empirical correlations between digital security awareness, risk perceptions, and cyber threat occurrences using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). The study contributes to understanding how information security awareness and perception influence individual experiences with cyber threats.
